mutate-exclusion-reasons.VerbDictionary.cs: vocabulary data — a HashSet<string> union of ~1,160 industry verbs across 34 domain categories; a surviving string mutation ("accrue" -> "") is killed only by a golden-contents assertion over every entry, which tests the data, not behaviour (owner ruling 2026-09-18, TODO §35)
mutate-exclusion-reasons.CollocationDictionary.cs: vocabulary data — noun-to-collocating-verb tables across 35 industry/technical domains; same string-literal mutation shape as VerbDictionary, same owner ruling (TODO §35)
mutate-exclusion-reasons.RoleSuffixDictionary.cs: vocabulary data — class-name role-suffix and expected-verb word lists; same string-literal mutation shape, same owner ruling (TODO §35)
mutate-exclusion-reasons.AbbreviationDictionary.cs: vocabulary data — 187 known-abbreviation entries (CLARITY-2); same string-literal mutation shape, same owner ruling (TODO §35)
mutate-exclusion-reasons.GenericTokenVocabulary.cs: vocabulary data — the three built-in word lists GenericTokenDetector classifies tokens against, extracted from GenericTokenDetector.cs so its own Classify/Score/IsMeaninglessSingleLetter logic stays mutated while only the tables are excluded (owner ruling 2026-09-18, TODO §35)
